input_serialization: JSON sorted keys, separators comma/colon, UTF8
assumptions: Laminar continuation of the common initial horizontal mean, same maintained background and original gradients, added wind plus uniform return, fixed waves and viscosity. Frozen-profile continuum viscous roll spectra; no x-varying eddies or nonautonomous propagator. The primary comparison restricts ky to at least six native transverse cells per wavelength. Existing 0/2 mm/s endpoints are retrospective; 0.75/1.25 mm/s are prospective.

records.interpretation: Continuum frozen-profile spectrum: every spanwise mode 1–31 is tested, with 32/48/64 beyond-native-band checks. Vertical convergence compares 48 and 72 basis modes. Fewer than four reference-grid cells per wavelength is unresolved; four cells is only a screening floor, not convergence. This operator does not replace the native centered-advection symbol by a continuum-validated discretization.
